acceptanceCriteria: A recorded decision chooses repository test, local read-only doctor, V1-0413 extension, or no check, with the reason, and names how host-file findings stay local, uncertain and non-authoritative.

If a check is chosen, a fixture reproduces both 2026-10-04 contradictions (draft-PR rule against the refusing hook, merge-approval rule against a merge-preauthorizing memory) and the check reports each one.
The check reports UNKNOWN, not a pass, when a host file it needs is absent or unreadable.
body: Filed 2026-10-04 from an owner-requested review of michael-denyer/pstack-claude (it pins skill rules with tests and checks that skill references resolve). Two contradictions between instruction layers reached agents on this machine before anyone saw them: (a) AGENTS.md standing publication approval required draft pull requests while a machine PreToolUse hook refuses the draft flag (V1-0640); (b) AGENTS.md said merging needs explicit approval while a saved Claude Code memory and ~/.codex/AGENTS.md (2026-10-03 standing merge preauthorization) told agents to arm or perform merges. Both were resolved by hand in an uncommitted AGENTS.md edit on 2026-10-04. Agents meet the conflict at run time and pick one side silently or ask. Spike: decide whether and where a check belongs. Candidates: a repository test over AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule pairs with a small table of known host-side settings; a read-only local doctor command that reads the host hook and memory files the owner points it at; or an extension of V1-0413 (per-host instruction load set) that also reports disagreeing rules. Host files outside the repository are not Git-pinned evidence, so any finding from them must be labelled local and uncertain (invariants 1 and 2) and never become authority (invariant 3).
title: Detect contradictions between project instructions and the owner's host hooks and agent memory
